name: MRFSMS
product: Virtual SMS / OTP number rental platform

youtube_channel.name: @Mr.FSmsPortal
youtube_channel.note: Official tutorial videos: login issues, how to safely use a purchased number, and other common problems.

live_feed.purpose: Shows which numbers are currently active/stable so users can choose a better number when OTP is failing.

payment_approval: Manual, verified by admin after reviewing the uploaded screenshot.
night_payment_policy: Payments submitted after 11:00 PM are usually reviewed and approved before 7:00 AM the next morning (sometimes sooner). Team is offline overnight; ask the customer to wait.
ban_policy: MRFSMS does not guarantee that a number/account will never be banned or logged out. This is stated in the Terms & Agreement accepted at signup. Ban/logout risk depends on the target platform's own policy and how the number is used, not on MRFSMS.
how_to_use_number_policy: After buying a number, the customer should open the 3-dot (⋮) menu in the app, which contains a written guide on safely using the number (warm-up period, daily message limits, avoiding groups/broadcasts early on, etc.).
otp_troubleshooting_order: Try Parallel Space (clone app) if the issue continues
Check the Live Feed on the dashboard and pick a currently stable number
Try a Golden Number if available (better success rate, not guaranteed)
If still unresolved, ask for Order ID, Service Name, Country
refund_policy: Successful/completed/delivered orders are non-refundable per the Terms & Agreement accepted at purchase. Genuine technical issues are reviewed case by case with the Order ID.

referral_program.condition: Friend signs up with the referral link and deposits at least 170 PKR

escalation: If the standard troubleshooting steps do not solve the issue, ask the user for Order ID, Service Name, Country, and (if relevant) a payment screenshot / transaction ID, then let them know the support team will review it.
